title: Всё ещё и больше не
description: Всё ещё и больше не: применяем правило в новых ситуациях, разбираем словарь, диалог и авторский текст без аудирования.
objectives: Использовать not ... anymore для прекратившейся ситуации
notes: She still works here означает, что работа продолжается.
She does not work here anymore означает, что прежняя ситуация прекратилась.

quality.method: author-review + schema/grader/editorial-reference checks; no independent teacher review

exercises.prompt: Выбери точный вариант: The café closed last year. It does not serve customers ___.
exercises.explanation: Not ... anymore описывает прекращение прежней деятельности.

exercises.prompt: Вставь слово из пары: still / anymore.

public_payload.sentence: He ___ lives in the same house; he has not moved.

exercises.editorial_answer: He still lives in the same house; he has not moved.
exercises.explanation: Отсутствие переезда подтверждает продолжающееся still lives.

exercises.prompt: Собери предложение: «Я больше не пользуюсь тем адресом.»
exercises.editorial_answer: I do not use that address anymore.
exercises.explanation: Not ... anymore сообщает об изменении по сравнению с прошлым.

exercises.prompt: Исправь ошибку в указанной конструкции, сохраняя остальные слова и смысл.

public_payload.sentence: She does not works here anymore.

accepted: She does not work here anymore.

exercises.reference_answer: She does not work here anymore.
exercises.incorrect_answer: She does not works here anymore.
exercises.editorial_answer: She does not work here anymore.
exercises.explanation: После does not нужен work, а anymore остаётся в конце.

public_payload.passage: The old café near our school does not open anymore. Its former owner still lives upstairs, but the ground floor is now a small bookshop. Some neighbours still call the building “the café”, which can confuse new visitors. The bookshop owner has put a clear sign outside, although she does not mind people remembering the earlier business.

exercises.explanation: Кафе закрыто, но здание используется и бывший владелец продолжает жить наверху.

exercises.prompt: Соедини слова с переводом в контексте урока.
exercises.editorial_answer: still — всё ещё; anymore — больше (в отрицании); continue — продолжаться; former — бывший
exercises.explanation: В этих контекстах: still — всё ещё; anymore — больше (в отрицании); continue — продолжаться; former — бывший.

public_payload.passage: The old café near our school does not open anymore. Its former owner still lives upstairs, but the ground floor is now a small bookshop. Some neighbours still call the building “the café”, which can confuse new visitors. The bookshop owner has put a clear sign outside, although she does not mind people remembering the earlier business.

options.label: The former owner sells books only upstairs.
Some neighbours still use the old name.

exercises.editorial_answer: Some neighbours still use the old name.
exercises.explanation: Старая привычка называния сохраняется после смены бизнеса.

lines.speaker: Собеседник
lines.text: Do you still attend the Tuesday class?

options.label: No, I do not attend it anymore.
No, I not attend it still anymore.
No, I do not attends it anymore.

exercises.editorial_answer: No, I do not attend it anymore.
exercises.explanation: Do not attend ... anymore сохраняет отрицание и начальную форму.

public_payload.sentence: A person who held a role previously is a ___ holder of that role.

exercises.explanation: Former обозначает прежнюю, уже не текущую роль.
